# RUSTSEC-2023-0071

Marvin Attack timing sidechannel in
rsa 0.9.x, pulled in transitively by adb_client v3 (ADB device
auth). Upstream advisory says "No fixed upgrade is available!".
Threat model is mitigated for desktop ADB host-side use:
attacker would need physical/local access AND the ability to
drive many timing-measured auth attempts. Revisit when rsa
ships a fix or adb_client switches RSA implementations.
rsa 0.9.10 has a second dependent, jsonwebtoken 10.4.0
(`rust_crypto`), reached via the restate chain described under
RUSTSEC-2026-0387 below. That path is never exercised, because
restate verifies EdDSA tokens only.

Drop when rsa ships a fix for the Marvin Attack (or adb_client switches RSA implementations) and no other dependent still pins a vulnerable rsa.
